basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old graphic designer from Vancouver, Canada. I'm passionate about electronic music and psychedelic art. I spend my weekends exploring the local music scene or taking road trips with my Doberman Pinscher. I'm usually online late at night after work. I'm currently single and enjoy meeting new people who share my interests in art and music.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a diploma in graphic design from a local college and have been working in a creative agency for the past two years. My interest in music and art has led me to explore various online communities, where I've picked up knowledge about different music genres and digital art techniques.
